# Getting Support

Thank you for using **Baton**!

## Questions, Ideas & Troubleshooting
- **Discussions**: Use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/YIOYIOIOI/baton/discussions) for setup help, Tailscale / Cloudflare Tunnel networking tips, workflow questions, and feature ideas.
- **Diagnostics**: Before asking for help, run:
  ```bash
  baton doctor --json
  # or from source checkout:
  npm run doctor -- --json
  ```
  Attach the redacted output (never include `~/.baton/token` or API keys).

## Bug Reports & Feature Requests
- Search existing [Issues](https://github.com/YIOYIOIOI/baton/issues) first to avoid duplicates.
- Open a new issue using the **Bug Report** or **Feature Request** form.

## Security Vulnerabilities
- **Do not** disclose security vulnerabilities in public Issues or Discussions.
- Follow [.github/SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) and submit a private report via **GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting** (`Security -> Advisories -> Report a vulnerability`).
